items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for a finite morphism of algebraic spaces carrying sheaves of rings: the canonical map comparing the tensor product with the pushforward of the tensor product is an isomorphism (statement lines 542-564). The proof writes the map as an adjoint, reduces to stalks at geometric points, identifies the stalk of the pushforward as a finite direct sum over the lifts of the point and checks the resulting distributive identity, using the pullback and pushforward stalk descriptions. The stalk computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
